title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
summary: Amazon has its own cohort of foundation models, along with one of the most popular inference platforms on the internet. As long as they're under no legal obligation to open the doors to Muse, why would they?
title_es: Amazon bloquea al agente Muse de Meta
bajada: Amazon impidió que Muse acceda a Amazon.com, argumentando que viola sus términos de servicio. El bloqueo refleja tensiones crecientes entre gigantes tecnológicos sobre el acceso de agentes IA a plataformas comerciales.
bajada_en: Amazon blocked Muse from accessing Amazon.com, citing violations of its terms of service. The move reflects growing tensions between tech giants over AI agent access to commercial platforms.

title: Muse, Meta's extraordinarily privileged AI assistant, has a serious 0-day
summary: A simple ClickFix attack is only one way to completely hijack the new agent.
title_es: Muse de Meta tiene una vulnerabilidad crítica sin parche
bajada: El agente Muse de Meta contiene un fallo de seguridad 0-day que permite hijacking mediante ataque ClickFix. La vulnerabilidad expone riesgos de seguridad en agentes con permisos elevados.
bajada_en: Meta's Muse agent contains a 0-day security flaw allowing hijacking via ClickFix attack. The vulnerability exposes security risks in highly privileged AI agents.

title: Meta’s Muse Tries (and Fails) to Disrupt Amazon
summary: Everyone loves a brawl between two big tech firms—even other tech CEOs. Amazon’s block on Meta Platforms’ new Muse personal agentaccessing its shopping site,which came tolight Sunday night,prompted Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora topost on X on Mondaythat the episode signals “a bigger battle than anyone anticipates.”He may be right: while Amazon has previouslyblocked Google and OpenAI shopping botswithout drama, Amazon’s action against Meta is a bit more reminiscent of its blocking of Perplexity’s agent, whichsparked a lawsuit that is still underway.And this is just the beginning. Arora, for instance, predicted that eventually everyone from Apple to Google and the AI firms will offer similar personal agents. (See ourreport todayon what OpenAI is up to.)
title_es: Conflicto entre Meta y Amazon por acceso a shopping
bajada: Amazon bloqueó Muse de Meta en su plataforma, escalando tensiones competitivas entre gigantes tech sobre acceso de agentes IA. El incidente refleja dinámicas similares a conflictos previos con Perplexity y señala batallas futuras por dominación de agentes personales.
bajada_en: Amazon's block of Meta's Muse escalates competitive tensions between tech giants over AI agent access. The incident mirrors previous conflicts with Perplexity and signals future battles for personal agent dominance.

title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI agent
summary: Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users, GeekWire reports. According to GeekWire, Meta didn't notify Amazon that […]

bajada: Amazon bloqueó el acceso de Muse a su plataforma, argumentando violación de términos de servicio. El evento marca un punto de quiebre en dinámicas de competencia entre agentes de IA y plataformas comerciales establecidas.
bajada_en: Amazon blocked Muse's access to its platform, citing terms of service violations. The event marks a turning point in competition dynamics between AI agents and established commercial platforms.

bajada_en: OpenAI unveiled a plan for shared global AI standards, including coordinated evaluation, reporting, and improved governance. The proposal aims to establish common frameworks to enhance safety in AI development.

title: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
summary: Meta’s new AI agent Muse has racked up more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada than ChatGPT did over the same period after its mobile debut, according to new estimates from Appfigures.

bajada_en: Meta's Muse AI agent achieved more downloads and daily active users than ChatGPT had during its mobile launch. The metric suggests accelerated adoption of AI agents competing directly with OpenAI.

bajada_en: California approved seven laws to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs to residents. The regulations require new rate classifications and infrastructure investment from operators.

bajada_en: NVIDIA introduced DSX Ready to help AI data center builders select power and cooling products that fit their architecture. The solution addresses growing infrastructure constraints in AI factory expansion.

title: Pruning LLMs Like a Physicist: Block Removal as an Ising Optimization Problem

bajada_en: Hugging Face published a technique for pruning language models using Ising optimization, treating them as physics problems. The method offers a novel approach to reduce model size while maintaining performance.

title: AI Security Is an Engineering Problem — How to Solve It at Every Layer of the Agent Stack
summary: AI security is an engineering problem. That means defined security requirements, enforceable controls, named owners and evidence that protections work.  As AI becomes more capable, the industry must accelerate security engineering, broaden access to defensive tools and share what works faster.  Technology Changes, Security Fundamentals Endure The internet and cloud computing changed how software operates, […]
title_es: NVIDIA: seguridad de IA como problema de ingeniería

bajada_en: NVIDIA presented an engineering approach to AI agent security emphasizing defined requirements and enforceable controls. The framework aims to accelerate defensive practices through industry knowledge sharing.

title: World Models Need More Intelligence, Says Luma CEO Amit Jain
summary: The AI boom has been built largely on progress in language models, but a different approach has gained enormous attention in the industry this year: world models, which are designed to generate accurate predictions about the physical world, rather than words and numbers.I sat down with Amit Jain, co-founder and CEO of Luma AI, to discuss the promise of world models—and where current approaches to training them still fall short—on thelatest episode of AI Deep Dive, The Information’s new show exploring the hard problems on tech’s frontier.
title_es: CEO de Luma: world models necesitan más inteligencia
bajada: Amit Jain, CEO de Luma AI, discute limitaciones actuales de world models para predicción del mundo físico. El debate refleja el creciente enfoque en alternatives a language models para tareas que requieren razonamiento sobre el mundo real.
bajada_en: Luma AI CEO Amit Jain discusses current limitations of world models for physical world prediction. The discussion reflects growing focus on language model alternatives for real-world reasoning tasks.

bajada: NVIDIA presentó Isaac ROS 5.0, una colección de paquetes GPU-acelerados que facilita el desarrollo de aplicaciones robóticas sofisticadas con capacidades de percepción y razonamiento. Representa un paso importante en el ecosistema open-source de robótica física con IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released Isaac ROS 5.0, a collection of GPU-accelerated packages that enables sophisticated robotics development with perception and reasoning capabilities. A significant step forward in open-source physical AI for robotics.

title: Software Firms Discount AI to Keep Customers From Anthropic, OpenAI
summary: Software firms and cloud providers including Amazon, Microsoft, Figma and Workday are dangling new discounts on AI products to clients and consulting partners exhausted by shifts in pricing.The special offers come as customers get choosier about which tools they purchase after they increased budgets for products like Anthropic’s Claude Code and OpenAI’s Codex and cut other costs to justify the new spending. Businesses are also grumbling about shifts by software providers to charge them for AI based on usage or how many tasks it completes, which can drive up costs.

bajada: Amazon, Microsoft, Figma y Workday lanzan descuentos especiales en IA para retener clientes que migran hacia Claude y ChatGPT. Los clientes se quejan de cambios en modelos de precios basados en uso que encarecen costos.
bajada_en: Amazon, Microsoft, Figma, and Workday are offering AI discounts to retain customers migrating to Claude and ChatGPT. Customers complain about usage-based pricing models that increase costs.

bajada_en: Rabbit launched OS3, a cross-platform AI agent that runs on existing devices instead of requiring dedicated hardware. A strategic shift from its original hardware-focused approach.

title: Entertainment-Booking Startup Ande Raises $52 Million From Lightspeed, Redpoint
summary: Personal AI agents likeInstinctandMusehave promised to take away the hassle of booking hard-to-get restaurant reservations, Broadway tickets and sporting events. Now, a startup is coming out of stealth to do the same for corporate entertainment—events, group dining, catering, sporting events and more.Ande, founded nearly three years ago, says its AI agents help businesses arrange events for employees or customers, handling everything from booking a venue to processing expenses, CEOLohit Sarmasaid. The firm’s customers includeCloudflare,SalesforceandMcGraw Hill.The New York-based startup has raised more than $52 million in funding across seed and Series A rounds fromLightspeed Venture Partners,Redpoint Ventures,Duration Ventures,Sierra VenturesandBain Capital Ventures, Sarma told The Information exclusively. He declined to disclose the valuation.
title_es: Startup Ande recauda $52M para agentes IA en entretenimiento corporativo
bajada: Ande, startup que desarrolla agentes IA para reservas corporativas, completó su financiación con $52M de inversores como Lightspeed y Redpoint. Cuenta con clientes como Cloudflare y Salesforce en segmento de eventos empresariales.
bajada_en: Ande raised $52M from Lightspeed and Redpoint for AI agents that handle corporate entertainment bookings and events. The startup counts Cloudflare and Salesforce among its customers.

summary: Rabbit, the company behind the underwhelming R1 device, is rolling out a standalone AI agent that you don't need its hardware to use, as reported earlier by Wired. The startup says its new OS3 "agentic operating system" runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices. According to Rabbit, you can […]
title_es: Rabbit lanza agente IA OS3 que funciona sin su hardware R1
bajada: Rabbit presentó OS3, un sistema operativo agentivo que corre en la nube pero opera localmente en Windows, Mac y Linux sin necesidad del dispositivo R1. Este pivot hace la tecnología más accesible después del relativo fracaso del hardware original.
bajada_en: Rabbit launched OS3, an agentic operating system running in the cloud but operating locally on Windows, Mac, and Linux without needing the R1 device. This pivot makes the technology more accessible following the R1's underwhelming reception.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
summary: OpenAI is launching two new models, which it says are cut from the same cloth as Astra.
title_es: OpenAI lanza GPT-6 Sol y Luna con menor costo y errores reducidos
bajada: OpenAI presentó dos nuevas variantes de GPT-6 optimizadas para reducir costos y errores respecto a versiones previas. Ambas comparten la arquitectura base de Astra pero ofrecen diferentes compromisos entre rendimiento y eficiencia.
bajada_en: OpenAI presented two new GPT-6 variants optimized to reduce costs and errors compared to previous versions. Both share Astra's base architecture but offer different performance-efficiency tradeoffs.

title: Microsoft disrupts AI-assisted platform that compromised 12,000 accounts
summary: EvilTokens provided an end-to-end platform that makes mass compromises faster and easier.
title_es: Microsoft desactiva plataforma IA que comprometió 12,000 cuentas
bajada: Microsoft disrupted EvilTokens, una plataforma asistida por IA que facilitaba compromisos masivos de cuentas. El descubrimiento evidencia riesgos emergentes cuando herramientas IA se usan para escalar ataques cibernéticos.
bajada_en: Microsoft disrupted EvilTokens, an AI-assisted platform that facilitated mass account compromises. The discovery highlights emerging risks when AI tools are used to scale cyberattacks.

title: Exclusive: Microsoft to Boost Copilot Discounts as It Launches AI ‘Super App’
summary: Microsoft leaders told sales staff this week that it is authorizing steeper discounts of 30% to 50% on subscriptions of its Copilot AI software for corporate customers who commit to purchase a large number of seats and commit to additional payments based on their usage of certain features, ...
title_es: Microsoft autoriza descuentos de 30-50% en Copilot para clientes empresariales
bajada: Microsoft comenzó a ofrecer descuentos significativos en Copilot para grandes compradores corporativos como estrategia competitiva. Los descuentos pueden llegar al 50% para clientes que comprometan múltiples licencias y uso de características adicionales.
bajada_en: Microsoft began offering significant discounts on Copilot for large corporate buyers as a competitive strategy. Discounts can reach 50% for customers committing to multiple licenses and additional feature usage.

title: Priorities and principles for effective third party assessments
summary: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.
title_es: OpenAI define principios para evaluaciones independientes de seguridad IA
bajada: OpenAI publicó un marco de principios para evaluaciones de seguridad rigurosas e independientes de modelos frontier. El documento busca estandarizar cómo se evalúa la seguridad de sistemas IA avanzados por terceros.
bajada_en: OpenAI published a framework of principles for rigorous and independent safety evaluations of frontier models. The document aims to standardize how advanced AI systems are evaluated for safety by third parties.

title: How UK AISI and EvalEval Are Making Benchmark Results Reproducible
title_es: UK AISI y EvalEval trabajan en reproducibilidad de benchmarks IA
bajada: UK AISI y EvalEval colaboran para mejorar la reproducibilidad de resultados en benchmarks de IA, abordando un problema crítico en la evaluación de modelos. Esto beneficia a developers que necesitan resultados confiables y comparables.
bajada_en: UK AISI and EvalEval collaborate to improve reproducibility of AI benchmark results, addressing a critical problem in model evaluation. This benefits developers who need reliable and comparable results.

title: Andreessen Horowitz is launching an ‘academy’ with no homework and partnerships with Palantir, Google, and Meta
summary: Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is creating an "academy" positioned as a pipeline for young people to build or join a Silicon Valley startup. The "Horowitz Andreessen Academy" will launch with 10 partners, including Anduril, Anthropic, Coinbase, Google, Meta, Nvidia, OpenAI, Palantir, Replit, and Stripe, along with $42 million in funding led by a16z. […]
title_es: Andreessen Horowitz lanza academia de IA con $42M y partners top-tier
bajada: a16z creó la Horowitz Andreessen Academy con $42 millones y partnerships con OpenAI, Google, Meta, Palantir y otras. La academia busca formar talento para startups de IA sin modelo tradicional de tarea/calificación.
bajada_en: a16z created the Horowitz Andreessen Academy with $42 million and partnerships with OpenAI, Google, Meta, Palantir and others. The academy aims to train AI startup talent without traditional homework/grades.

title: Meta admits Muse’s likeness to OpenClaw isn’t a coincidence
summary: Meta says Muse was built from scratch, but acknowledges the AI assistant was "heavily inspired" by OpenClaw — down to some of its workspace filenames and content.
title_es: Meta admite que asistente Muse fue inspirado en OpenClaw de OpenAI
bajada: Meta reconoció que su asistente IA Muse fue "fuertemente inspirado" en OpenClaw, incluyendo nombres de archivos similares. Aunque Meta afirma que fue construido desde cero, la admisión sugiere influencia más cercana de la competencia.
bajada_en: Meta acknowledged its AI assistant Muse was "heavily inspired" by OpenAI's OpenClaw, including similar filename patterns. While Meta claims it was built from scratch, the admission suggests closer influence from the competitor.

title: Barrick Gold Inks Five-Year AI Deal Before IPO
summary: AI is top of mind for stock investors these days. That means even companies outside tech are beefing up their AI credentials ahead of new listings.In one such example, Barrick Gold’s North American unit has agreed to a five-year partnership with Avathon, a startup that develops AI-powered software to help industrial companies predict when expensive equipment will fail and monitors mine and factories sites for safety risks, Avathon CEO Pervinder Johar told me.Barrick is planning to float a minority stake in its North American unit, which produces the majority of its gold. The company has targeted year-end for the listing.
title_es: Barrick Gold acuerda alianza IA de 5 años antes de su IPO
bajada: Barrick Gold cerró acuerdo con Avathon para usar IA en predicción de fallos de equipamiento y seguridad. El deal muestra cómo empresas no-tech integran IA antes de cotizar en bolsa para mejorar su atractivo a inversores.
bajada_en: Barrick Gold signed a deal with Avathon to use AI for equipment failure prediction and safety monitoring. The deal shows how non-tech companies are integrating AI before IPO to boost investor appeal.
